_comment: Claude Code hook wiring for gates/claude-hook.js. Install with:
which copies this file to .claude/settings.json (it is not written there in the
repo because .claude/settings.json is a per-machine file that also carries model,
permission and MCP settings a developer may already have set — copying over it is
a decision for whoever owns the checkout, not for the repo).
PostToolUse runs gates/run.sh --fast on the edited file (~200ms, invariants.js
only) and blocks with exit 2 if it fails; either way it marks the turn dirty.
Stop runs the whole of gates/run.sh once and blocks with exit 2 if it fails.

hooks.statusMessage: Marking the turn for the gate
